notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
